title: A restaurant in Toronto

input.where: 100 Queen St W, Toronto, ON M5H 2N2, Canada

assumptions: A new federal corporation opening a restaurant in Toronto with staff and a fit-out, no alcohol. GST/HST registration applies once taxable sales pass the small supplier limit, so it is conditional. Ontario's food handler rule (O. Reg. 493/17) couldn't be read on ontario.ca (e-Laws is built in script), so it is set aside.

mustNotInclude.name: US and California filings
mustNotInclude.why: Canada's code is CA, like California's; no US filing applies in Toronto.

items.name: Business number and CRA program accounts
items.quote: Find out how to register for a business number (BN) and Canada Revenue Agency (CRA) program accounts for your business.

items.name: GST/HST registration (above the small supplier limit)
items.quote: You are no longer a small supplier and have to charge GST/HST on the supply that made you exceed $30,000 within the calendar quarter.

items.name: WSIB registration within 10 days of the first hire
items.quote: By law, most businesses need to register with the WSIB within 10 calendar days of hiring their first employee.

items.agency: City of Toronto, Municipal Licensing and Standards
